market_context: The Nasdaq-100 fell 3.46% to 28,384.85 (QQQ −3.47% to $690.49) as Intel's weak PC outlook and Amazon's AI-capex miss sparked a semiconductor rout; Sandisk sold off post-earnings despite a beat while T-Mobile and Gilead bucked the tape.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-10-30 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-05 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-05 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.name: Intel Corporation Common Stock
stocks.reason: Worst day since the 1970s after Thursday's after-close print: Q3 beat (adj. EPS $0.52 / revenue $16.51B) but Q4 guide of $15–16B revenue and $0.25 adj. EPS badly missed Street (~$17.1B / $0.43) on a prolonged PC slowdown from soaring memory costs plus an Israel fab shutdown; BofA cut to Neutral ($100 from $145) and D.A. Davidson also went to Neutral.
